evals.name: tdd-with-all-blockers-done
evals.prompt: Implement RSL-123 using TDD (all blocked-by tickets are Done).
evals.expected_output: Fetches the issue, validates blockers are Done, reads the linked PRD, runs the TDD red-green-refactor loop, opens a PR with the from:prd-<slug> label, and back-comments the Linear ticket with the PR URL.

evals.name: refuses-when-blocker-open
evals.prompt: Implement RSL-456 using TDD (blocked by RSL-123 which is In Progress).
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses, listing RSL-123 as an open blocker. No implementation begins.

evals.name: refuses-when-no-prd-label
evals.prompt: Implement RSL-789 using TDD (issue has no from:prd-* label).
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses, reporting that the issue wasn't created by /risoluto-to-issues — no linked PRD found.
